title: Pack school lunch
notes: Vegetarian, no nuts. Pack a meal plus 2 snacks first. Sweets are extra and optional (up to 2).

checks.label: 1 grain serving
checks.hint: Tap the picture to see examples
checks.exampleCaption: Bread, bagels, baguette, noodles, pasta, rice, crackers, tortillas, tortilla chips, pita

checks.label: 1 protein serving (no nuts)
checks.hint: Tap the picture to see examples
checks.exampleCaption: Cheese, yogurt, hummus, beans, tofu, hard-boiled egg

checks.label: 1 fruit or vegetable serving
checks.hint: Tap the picture to see examples
checks.exampleCaption: Apples, oranges, pears, berries, grapes, cucumber, carrot sticks, veggies and dip

checks.label: Snack 1: fruit or veg
checks.hint: Tap the picture to see examples
checks.exampleCaption: Apples, oranges, pears, berries, grapes, cucumber, carrot sticks, veggies and dip

checks.label: Snack 2: grain or dairy
checks.hint: Tap the picture to see examples
checks.exampleCaption: Crackers, oatmeal bar, yogurt, cheese, milk

checks.label: Snack 3 (optional extra fruit, veg, or grain)
checks.hint: Skip if you do not need it. Tap the picture for ideas.
checks.exampleCaption: Apples, oranges, pears, berries, grapes, cucumber, carrot sticks, veggies and dip

sections.title: Sweets (optional)
sections.intro: Pack meal and snacks first. Sweets are extra — up to 2.

checks.hint: Tap the picture to see examples

water.label: Refill water bottle and pack it
water.hint: Fill it with fresh water, then put it in the lunch bag.
